results.title: Results
results.subtitle: Aapki poori ki hui saari exams.
results.emptyHint: Exam poori hone aur result release hone par wo yahan dikhega.
results.pendingHint: Jaanch ho chuki hai ya ho rahi hai. Result taiyar hone par aapko bataya jayega.
results.question: Sawaal {position}
results.notReleased: Yeh result abhi release nahi hua hai.
results.standingHint: Aapki company ke sabhi logon ki tulna mein aapka behtareen result.
results.standingSuppressedHint: Sthaan tabhi dikhega jab aapki company ke kam se kam das logon ka result release ho chuka ho. Usse kam mein rank aapke baare mein kam aur aapke saathiyon ke baare mein zyada batayega.
results.standingNoneHint: Result release hote hi aapka sthaan yahan dikhega.

sitting.title: Meri exams
sitting.subtitle: Aapko di gayi exams.
sitting.empty: Abhi aapke liye koi exam nahi hai.
sitting.emptyHint: Jab manager koi exam assign karenge, wo yahan dikhegi.
sitting.confirmStartBody: Timer abhi shuru hoga aur server par chalega. Tab band karne se rukega nahi.
sitting.confirmSubmitBody: Aapne {total} mein se {answered} sawaal kiye hain. Submit ke baad jawab nahi badal sakte.
sitting.timeUpBody: Samay khatam hone par aapki exam apne aap submit ho gayi.
sitting.resultPending: Aapka result abhi release nahi hua hai. Taiyar hone par aapko bataya jayega.
sitting.startFailed: Yeh exam shuru nahi ho saki.

pending.suspended: Aapka account suspend kar diya gaya hai. Apne manager se sampark karein.

resetPassword.title: Naya password chunein
resetPassword.body: Apne account ke liye naya password daalein.
resetPassword.doneBody: Ab aap apne naye password se sign in kar sakte hain.
resetPassword.invalidBody: Password reset link kuch samay baad expire ho jaate hain, sirf ek baar chalte hain, aur usi browser mein kholne hote hain jahan se maange gaye the. Naya link maangein.

dashboard.subtitle: Aapke liye jo bhi baaki hai, ek jagah.

dashboard.myExamsHint: Aapko di gayi aur abhi khuli hui.
dashboard.nothingHereHint: Jab koi exam aapko di jayegi, ya kisi paper ko aapke dhyan ki zaroorat hogi, wo yahan dikhega.

dashboard.noTeamYet: Abhi kisi ne kuch nahi diya
dashboard.examPerformanceHint: Jo paper logon ne sach mein diye, sabse kamzor pehle.
dashboard.weeklyEngagementHint: Har hafte shuru aur poore hue attempts, training aur assessment ke hisaab se.
dashboard.departmentPerformanceHint: Har department aur outlet ka pass rate aur average score.
dashboard.liveActivityHint: Kisne kisko approve kiya, kisne role badla, kisne exam publish ki.
dashboard.trendsHint: Upar ka har aankda pichhle period se kitna badla.
